definitions.explanation: How well something or someone is functioning.
The musical pitch or the manner/style of speaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調子|ちょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: My computer hasn't been working well lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調子|ちょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
⟦{怒|おこ}った→怒る：00876_okoru⟧{調子|ちょうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: He spoke in an angry tone.
Judging from the tone of her voice, something unpleasant must have happened.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {調子|ちょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (in good condition/form, feeling good)
- {調子|ちょうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (in bad condition, feeling unwell)
- {調子|ちょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to get carried away, to get cocky)
- {調子|ちょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to tune [instrument]; to go along with someone)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{調子|ちょうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (keep it up, in that manner)

USAGE:
{調子|ちょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ has a negative connotation, suggesting someone is becoming overconfident or getting ahead of themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調子|ちょうし} (physical condition)
- ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調子|ちょうし} (machine's condition)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調子|ちょうし} (tone of voice)
